course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Who enters the result: a reference and two time boundaries
goal: Verify a typed customer filter and half-open hour boundary using two own requests.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P6. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A request was created exactly at 13:00. Does it belong to a “12 to 13” report? Define the exact period contract before checking references and minutes.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: A query expresses a set
paragraphs: 1C query language addresses the metadata model, not arbitrary SQL for modifying internal tables. SELECT chooses fields, FROM defines the source, andWHERE defines conditions. Begin with expected identities and values rather than selecting everything and hoping to understand later.

Preparation creates an own customer/service and 30/45 requests at 12:00/13:00 on November 2. Record their actual references. A growing infobase need not contain only two documents: the own reference defines the set; names are not keys.

sections.title: Continue your own P6 setup
paragraphs: Close Enterprise. Export a DT backup from Administration → Dump infobase; restore it into a new empty directory and verify the actual path. Preserve earlier functions/fields.

Use the existing Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги. Queries require no new permanent metadata object. Functions run in УчебныеДанные: Server and Server call enabled; Client/Global/Privileged disabled. Do not load a full CF over your work.

НовыйНаборРегистров is the P6 preparation helper. If already defined, retain its single definition and append only the new experience function. The Приложение.bsl caller belongs in the separate application handler. After one run, remove only the added startup call.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: Preparation creates two own requests of 30 and 45 minutes at 12:00 and 13:00. Дата >= Начало И Дата < Конец includes the first and excludes the second. The check verifies the first request’s actual reference, not just 30. An empty customer reference gives an empty result.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Pass values as parameters
paragraphs: Do not concatenate customer names or dates into query text. SetParameter supplies a typed value separately from structure. A customer reference is not its display string. A parameter cannot stand in for an arbitrary field name: choose structure from an allowlist and keep user values parameterized.

Pass a CatalogRef.Клиенты and two full date/time values.12:00 is included and 13:00 excluded. An empty reference of the same type is a separate negative input expected to return no rows; never concatenate a name or operator text.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: With an end boundary of 13:00, is a request exactly at 13:00 included?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. A half-open interval includes its start and excludes its end. Adjacent 12–13 and 13–14 windows therefore do not count the boundary request twice. Time conditions work together with the customer-reference filter.

sections.title: Periods have precise boundaries
paragraphs: UseDate>=Start ANDDate<End for an agreed half-open interval. IncludeStart and excludeEnd. A daily query must account for document time. Ordinary rows do not expose a last-second error; add records exactly on both boundaries.

A document exactly at the upper boundary distinguishes < from <=: the latter returns two rows/75 instead of one/30. Without boundary data both versions might agree. Verify the actual first-document reference as well as the total.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram checks membership in the worked 12–13 window. Define conditions before examining count and total. It changes no date and moves no request between windows.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

flowchart.caption: Which row enters the worked window
paths: 12:00 is included, 13:00 excluded. All conditions hold together; this filters rather than changes a document.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Replacing < with <= gives two requests and 75 minutes in the first window. Without a request exactly at the boundary, the error could go unnoticed. Fix the comparison contract instead of changing the expected total.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Result and cursor differ
paragraphs: Execute returns a query result; Select creates traversal; Unload materializes a value table. Choose by volume and needed operations. An empty result is not inherently an error. Reconcile identities, types, count and sum, then verify reading did not modify documents.

Two independent results check the one correct row/30 and the empty-key case. Reading changes no documents. Retain definitions and data but remove the startup call. Define a new expectation before changing the interval.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create new 20-minute and 40-minute requests at 12:00 and 13:00. Execute one parameterised query for 12–13 and 13–14:expect 20 and 40, one correct reference per window without overlap. An empty customer key must again give an empty result.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Explain why the boundary request belongs to the second window and not the first.
